subject.title: Fix live orphan session transcript visibility

question: Should OpenClaw accept same-agent owner-scoped live orphan transcript hits as visible when session visibility permits but the combined session store has no entry?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and source-backed, but it changes which private transcript snippets can surface through memory tools and overlaps active private-recall product work, so automation should not decide the boundary.

options.title: Accept Scoped Fallback
options.body: Approve this narrow same-agent fallback as intended behavior while keeping cross-agent and basename-only orphan hits fail-closed.

options.title: Require Gateway Replay Proof
options.body: Ask for live gateway memory_search or memory-wiki replay proof with an index refresh before deciding the boundary.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Recall
options.body: Pause this narrow PR and resolve the behavior only through the default-off remember-across-conversations product direction.

recommendation.title: Accept Scoped Fallback
recommendation.body: Approve this narrow same-agent fallback as intended behavior while keeping cross-agent and basename-only orphan hits fail-closed.

likelyOwner.reason: The active broader private-recall PR is the closest product-direction context for this transcript visibility choice.
